name: Stepper-TS-TW
blurb: Multi-step form with animated slide transitions between steps.
description: Wizard component with numbered step indicators, slide-in content transitions, and back/next navigation. Framer Motion-powered animations with dynamic step completion.
use_when: Onboarding flows and multi-step forms requiring clear progress indication and smooth content transitions.
avoid_when: Simple single-page forms — adds Framer Motion dependency and animation overhead.
a11y: Step indicators and navigation buttons semantic and clickable. No keyboard navigation between steps; animations ignore prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: renderStepIndicator
props.type: (props: { step: number; currentStep: number; onStepClick: (clicked: number) => void; }) => ReactNode
